title: EIPO: A Framework for Emotionally Intelligent Conversational User Interfaces in Behavior-Change Support

live_model.evidence: "GPT-4 Turbo will be employed as the automated evaluator to ensure consistent and scalable assessment"; "the teacher model (GPT-4 Turbo) will provide an improved emotional response and feedback" (Sec. 3).

prompt.location: EGS evaluation prompt described, not printed

claim.metric: mean EGS scores of student models (Qwen-2.5-7B, GPT-3.5 Turbo) as judged by GPT-4 Turbo

notes: The live model is judge and teacher only; all reported numbers describe the student models and DPO fine-tuning. No snapshot named (preprint 2026-05).
